facts.business: KP Energy Limited is an Indian renewable energy company engaged in wind and solar power generation, EPCC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning) project development, and power transmission infrastructure.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Guided by an ambitious vision of achieving 10 GW+ of renewable energy capacity by 2030

key_risks: Revenue recognition accuracy in fixed-price EPCC development contracts due to customized and complex nature
Unbilled revenue from sale of power subject to variation pending confirmation from regulatory authority and customers
Right of Way expenses incurred during EPC contract development involving land ownership verification and authorization trails
facts.related_party_note: Reimbursement of Expense Recoverable from Subsidiaries: Rs 394.64 lakhs (March 31, 2026); Investments in subsidiaries and associates including equity shares, capital contribution in LLPs, and deemed capital contributions.
